articles.title: India slips to 125th in Global Passport Index 2026, offers visa-free access to 26 destinations
articles.description: India's passport has dropped to 125th globally in the 2026 rankings, offering visa-free access to only 26 destinations. This marks a decline from last year's position, placing it behind several nations including the Philippines and Morocco. While India outranks some South Asian neighbours like Nepal and Bangladesh, it still requires visas for major global powers. European nations continue to dominate the top spots in global travel mobility.

articles.title: ‘We Want Fireworks!’: Laura Loomer’s Savage Nudge At Netanyahu To ‘Quickly Bomb’ Khamenei’s Funeral
articles.description: Far-right activist and longtime Donald Trump ally Laura Loomer has ignited a major controversy after a series of social media posts about the funeral of former Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. Loomer referred to the funeral as a "target rich environment," suggested the Israel Defense Forces had "the opportunity to do the funniest thing," and later wrote that she would "never say no" to seeing the U.S. or Israel bomb "a bunch of jihadis."Her latest remarks came after another viral post in which she reacted to footage of mourners chanting "Death to America" by asking, "Speaking of fireworks... where is the IDF when you need them?" The comments have fueled intense debate online, with supporters defending her stance and critics accusing her of encouraging violence amid already heightened tensions between Israel and Iran.
